title: py-polars
label: py-polars
checked: Column names, data types, and values of 314 results: data frame methods, functions, joins, grouping, windows, sorting, casts, SQL, and the str, dt, list, struct, and arr namespaces. Identical inputs in both implementations.
description: scripts/pyfixtures.py runs each case in py-polars and writes tests/fixtures/py/expected.json. tests/pyfixtures.php runs the same cases in phpolars and compares the results. phpolars embeds the Polars Rust crate 0.55.2; py-polars 1.43.2 is the release with the closest Rust core. Error statistics cover numeric values only.
inputs: Fixed data frames built identically in scripts/pyfixtures.py and tests/pyfixtures.php: a 6-row frame of integers, floats, strings, booleans, dates, datetimes, and lists with nulls in every column; lookup tables; a sorted time series; and quotes for as-of joins.

comparison.applies_to: Results without floats; column names, data types, integers, strings, booleans, temporal values, and null positions
Finite floats; no absolute term, so a zero reference requires an exact zero, and all other values compare exactly
Expected exceptions; exception class name, message not compared

exclusions: NaN, INF, and -INF are encoded as {"$float": "NaN"}, {"$float": "INF"}, and {"$float": "-INF"} and compared exactly; they count as values compared and are excluded from the error statistics.
Methods and arguments without a case are not compared.
